div.div: مُرْجَأٌ [pass. part. n. of 4]. It is said in the Kur [ix. 107], (S, K,) as some read, (S,) وَآخَرُونَ, مُرْجَؤُونَ لِأَمْرِ ٱللّٰهِ, (S, K,) or, as others read, مُرْجَوْنَ, (S,) meaning [And others are] delayed [for the execution of the decree of God,] until God shall cause to betide them what He willeth. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
